prompt:
Create a square transparent game inventory atlas: sixteen separate clothing and armor object icons, NO people, no bodies, no mannequins. Exact invisible4 columns x4 rows, row-major sequence. Center each group at grid coordinates12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% along each axis. Each icon is SMALL, at most55% cell width and55% cell height, with very generous transparent gutters. All sleeves, ties, guards and paired pieces must stay fully within own cell. Consistent front or slight three-quarter view; matched pairs count as a single group. Original Ming-inspired wuxia, hand-painted watercolor/gouache, fine warm brown outlines, ivory/jade/coral accents with natural materials, soft top-left light, clear rounded readable silhouettes. No words, symbols resembling writing, labels, numbers, frames, visible grid, scenery, glow or shadows. Transparent empty canvas around objects. Items left to right then top to bottom:
1. Cream grey cross collar training jacket, wide dark sash, rolled sleeves
2. Indigo quilted padded jacket with diamond stitching and cloth toggles
3. Brown sleeveless soft leather armor, overlapping panels, diagonal straps
4. Dark brown shaped hard leather cuirass, brass rivets, side lacing
5. Light bamboo slat vest, green cloth trim, crossed back cords
6. Black lacquered lamellar cuirass, red lacing, short protective skirt
7. Silver grey fine chainmail shirt, short sleeves, cloth bound collar
8. Dark green brigandine coat, ordered brass rivets, split lower hem
9. Simple curved black iron breast and back plates with thick leather shoulder straps
10. Articulated steel shoulder and upper arm armor with brown leather straps
11. Pair of brown leather forearm guards with vertical iron strips and twin buckles
12. Articulated silver plate hand guards over black leather palms, narrow wrist straps
13. Grey cloth shin wraps with pale curved wooden splints and long crossed ties
14. Pair of rounded iron knee guards with small hinged plates and padded lining
15. Dark iron broad brimmed helmet, shallow rounded crown, brown chin strap
16. Rounded grey iron helmet, layered neck lames, reddish brown padded lining

visual_review.notes: 16 clothing/armor groups in expected row-major order, no human figures. All silhouettes appear complete and separated; matched guards remain within their own group. Some forms exceed requested55-percent occupancy and grid row boundaries may need measured regions. Shoulder armor is depicted with a small joining chest plate; hand guards are fully enclosed metal-backed gloves. Neither is a literal manufacturing blueprint.
